name: md-adf
description: Workspace orchestration for Markdown-ADF converter implementations.

scripts.conformance: npm run build --workspace packages/js && node tools/conformance/run-all.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: poetry -C packages/python run ruff check --config ../../pyproject.toml src tests ../../tools/conformance/run-python.py && poetry -C packages/python run mypy --config-file ../../pyproject.toml src tests ../../tools/conformance/run-python.py
scripts.bump:major: npm version major --workspace packages/js --no-git-tag-version && poetry -C packages/python version major && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.bump:minor: npm version minor --workspace packages/js --no-git-tag-version && poetry -C packages/python version minor && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.bump:patch: npm version patch --workspace packages/js --no-git-tag-version && poetry -C packages/python version patch && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:js && npm run publish:py
scripts.publish:py: poetry -C packages/python build && poetry -C packages/python publish
scripts.release:publish: npm run publish:all && npm run tag
scripts.tag: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && git tag v$(node tools/release/current-version.mjs) && git push origin v$(node tools/release/current-version.mjs)
scripts.test: npm run validate:fixtures && npm run conformance
